question: At what specific time is this bathing declared praiseworthy and effective?
premises: The bathing is praised at the time of eclipse.
Its efficacy is restricted to that time.
This restriction is affirmed as the speaker's word.
inference: The bathing is praiseworthy only at the time of eclipse.
plain_english: It is praiseworthy at the time of eclipse, and not otherwise; this is my word.
